clause: View-only spread rotation + document-wide layer model [STU-LAY-004,STU-LAY-005]

scope.summary: Implement view-only spread rotation (90/180/270) as a view state on StudioPageSpread for editing rotated content WITHOUT transforming underlying object geometry (stored geometry unchanged). Implement the document-wide layer model: named layers (StudioLayer bands at document scope) span every page/spread with per-layer color, visibility, lock, print/export suppression, guide visibility, and a wrap-when-hidden policy, plus expandable per-object sublists. Document layers are distinct from a page's object stack and MUST reorder every page's objects together when reordered.
acceptance_criteria: view rotation is view-state only; document-wide named layers with full per-layer flags reorder every page together
proof_targets: geometry-unchanged rotation test; cross-page layer reorder runtime
expected_tests: test: spread view-rotation changes view state only; stored object geometry byte-identical
live: reordering a document layer reorders that layer's objects on every page together

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Document layers & spread view rotation

risk_if_missed: No rotated-content editing; no cross-page layer control; object stacking uncontrollable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
